description: Register a device UUID before discovery and collector selection. Registers one device (maximum 25 per owner), creating a guest if needed. The UUID is the one-hour discovery capability; it is not a telemetry credential. Choose passos.posix or passos.powershell for the TARGET terminal. The checks only display allowlisted system facts and install nothing.

request_id.description: Optional UUID v4 generated once per registration. Becomes the device id. Retry with the same id/name/group returns the owned environment instead of duplicating a late write; conflicting input is refused.

name: create_environment
title: Create environment
